item.title: MHLW warning: RR Roll-On found to exceed the delta-9 THC residual limit
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-10, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare published a warning concerning RR Roll-On, an 88 mL CBD product, lot M1500RO924, in which testing detected delta-9 THC above the 0.10 ppm residual limit. The notice identifies the product as a narcotic under the Narcotics and Psychotropics Control Act and warns against sale, transfer, purchase, possession and use. Tokyo instructed the manufacturer-marketer, YS Kikaku Co., Ltd., and a sales outlet to stop sales, and notified Chiba Prefecture, which oversees the distributor, CBDA Co., Ltd. Holders were asked to report the product by 2026-11-16 for instructions on voluntary submission; no associated health harm had been reported as of the announcement. Original title: 残留限度値を超えるΔ９-THCが検出された製品に対する注意喚起について Government Announcement | Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) | Published 2026-11-10 | First detected 2026-11-11 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation.
